title: Plans
intro: Manage plan definitions and explicit market prices.
planFormHelp: Choose the plan features, limits, visibility and status. Changes are checked against the current contract before saving.
priceFormHelp: Enter an explicit market price for this plan.
unknownFeaturesHelp: This plan has unsupported feature codes ({{features}}). Feature changes are locked so those codes are not lost.
limitsHelp: Leave a limit blank to leave it undefined.
invalid: Check the marked fields and select at least one feature.
name: Name
marketHelp: Choose currency and billing interval explicitly. Country, region and interval count refine the lookup. No currency conversion is performed.
noMatches: No matching plans. Clear the filters to review the catalogue.
deleteHelp: Delete this catalogue record for {{name}}? The server checks existing references before accepting deletion.
result.success: Saved. The catalogue has been refreshed.
result.invalid: Check your input. The request was rejected.
result.refused: This action is no longer available. Your access has been refreshed.
result.stale: The catalogue changed or the record is still referenced. Refresh and review it before opening a new edit.
result.contract: The contract is unavailable. Actions are stopped.
result.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Review refreshed records before deciding whether another command is needed.
systemHelp: The system default plan cannot be deleted. Its name and publication setting are locked.
featureHelp: Supported feature codes: ATTENDANCE, ANALYTICS, OVERVIEW, TEAM_MANAGEMENT.
